name: DevHunt
measures: Developer tools submitted and launched per month, by category
about: DevHunt is a launch site for developer tools. Its open data API publishes monthly counts of tools submitted and launched, the share in each category, and a dated log of changes to its pricing, launch queue, moderation and categories. We use it to check whether the rise in Uneed launches shows up on a second launch site, and combine the two in the score.
attribution: Data: DevHunt (devhunt.org), CC BY 4.0. Monthly counts from https://devhunt.org/open-data, displayed as complete-month trends and year-over-year changes.
limitations: It is one site, mostly indie makers of developer tools, so its growth can reflect its own popularity rather than more software being built.
A new submit form on 27 September 2026 multiplied submissions, so later months can't be compared with earlier ones.
Pricing, the paywall and the free launch queue changed several times. Launches follow the queue more than demand, and submissions moved with the paywall.
Counts are recomputed daily. Tools removed later leave every month, and makers can edit pricing, GitHub links and categories, so history can change.
Categories overlap and were tagged onto older tools once, in 2026, so their history is a classifier's reading, not what makers chose at the time.
